metadata.title: Catching a Milky Way open cluster in its last breath

notes: No eligible stars. ASCC 92 (Alessi 31/MWSC 2723) is an open cluster, not an individual star. The paper's “unbound” stars are energetically unbound from the cluster, not Galactic unbound candidates: the total-versus-critical-energy analysis concerns cluster escape (T:p5-b4; I:p6-b0), and the cluster is described as moving with Galactic rotation (T:p4-b9). The Gaia IDs in Table A1 are listed only as cluster members absent from the comparison sample (T:p8-b0), not as stars identified as unbound from the Milky Way.
